Hey, folks! This mod simply turns the front view of the blue couch into a piano. I know it's nothing extraordinary 'cos I'm not that good with sprites but here it is.

This was just something I wanted for my own game, so I figured I'd share it here. The main download is the default[font=Courier New] furniture.xnb [/font]with the couch added in, but if you want to replace something else or have made edits to your own[font=Courier New] furniture.xnb [/font]you can download the optional file that is simply the PNG of the piano and overlay it over whatever you want. 

To install, make a backup of your files and unzip the [font=Courier New]Content [/font]folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley[/font] folder, overwriting everything. If you're using Steam, the location should be[font=Courier New] "Steam\steamapps\Stardew Valley".

[/font]Enjoy!
